title: Austria Beat World Cup Debutants Jordan 3-1; Arnautovic Scores from Penalty Spot
detail: Austria defeated World Cup debutants Jordan 3-1 in Group D play at the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Marko Arnautovic converted a penalty as Austria secured a comfortable victory over Jordan, who were making their first-ever appearance at a FIFA World Cup.

media.caption: Austria beat World Cup debutants Jordan 3-1 with Arnautovic scoring from the penalty spot
